purpose: Exact wire shapes the frontend binds to (web/src/console/recruiting/recruitingApi.ts). The backend lane + openapi integrator must match these or flag the deviation — the scout digest is the shared source; fields not named by the digest are marked assumption:true.
error_envelope: { error: { message: string } }; publish 422 additionally carries top-level checks: [{key, ok, note}]; 401/403 rendered as denied (never as error), 409 rendered as conflict + reload
client_note: clients/ts predates the recruiting tag, so DTOs are module-local and the ConsoleApiClient is cast once at the transport boundary; integrator swap-to-generated-types is mechanical (names mirror the expected components.schemas).

RecruitPostingView.fields: id, code(JP-), role_title, company, worksite, employment_type(REGULAR|RESIDENT_SHIFT|PART_TIME|POOL_DAILY), scope(INTERNAL|EXTERNAL), headcount, hired_count, deadline(date|null), requirements[], status(DRAFT|PUBLISHED|CLOSED), position_ref(string|null), updated_at, stage_counts{applied,screening,interview,offer}

RecruitApplicantView.fields: id, applicant_no(APL-), posting_id, name, stage(APPLIED|SCREENING|INTERVIEW|OFFER|HIRED), hold, doc_requested, rejected, reject_reason(enum|null), assessment{score,assessed_by,assessed_at}|null, profile_lines[], source_document(string|null), hired_employee_id(string|null), applied_at, updated_at

RecruitOfferView.fields: id, version, amount(string-decimal), amount_period(MONTHLY|DAILY), reply_deadline(date|null), status(EXTENDED|SUPERSEDED|WITHDRAWN|ACCEPTED|DECLINED), created_at

RecruitStageEventView.fields: id, action(string; labeled client-side: CREATED/ADVANCED/ASSESSED/HELD/RELEASED/DOCUMENTS_REQUESTED/REJECTED/REINSTATED/OFFER_EXTENDED/OFFER_ADJUSTED/OFFER_WITHDRAWN/OFFER_REPLY/HIRED/VIEWED, unknown actions rendered raw), occurred_at, actor_name?, note?
assumption: entire shape — weakest contract point, rendered tolerantly

dtos.RecruitTalentPoolItem: applicant_no, name, role_title, reason(enum), rejected_at (all from digest)

operations_bound: POST /postings/{id}/preflight -> {checks:[{key,ok,note}], publishable}; UI check-key labels: position_worksite, headcount_deadline, duplicate_posting (unknown keys rendered raw)
GET /applicants/{id} -> {applicant, offers[], events[]} (server-side audited PII view)
POST /applicants/{id}/offer {amount, amount_period, reply_deadline} (422 ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED surfaced verbatim)
GET /api/v1/branches (existing generated op) — hire-form branch reference data
deliberate_omissions: POOL_DAILY hire CTA is not rendered (backend 422 POOL_REGISTRATION_UNAVAILABLE until the workforce registry exists — no dead/fake control)
Talent-pool -> workforce-pool conversion button omitted (no workforce crate)
Candidate self-service persona deferred (no external principal)
OFR- passkey inbox receipt deferred — record-reply buttons substitute
reconciliation: Every mutation success re-reads list + open posting + open applicant card from the server (no locally-fabricated state); expected_updated_at from the last server read; 409 shows conflict copy and reloads.
